description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDecorator class, which provides helper methods to manage and enhance CandidateHistory entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, including setting related entities and formatting data.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class to assist with CandidateHistory entity management and formatting in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateHistory entity.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the Candidate entity in CandidateHistory by its ID.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the Vacancy entity in CandidateHistory by its ID.

methods.name: setInterviewByInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the Interview entity in CandidateHistory by its ID.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who performed the action in CandidateHistory.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryAction
methods.description: Returns the human-readable description of the CandidateHistory action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the action was performed.
